## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复普通退出管理器会连带关闭 Codex 桌面和 CLI 实例的问题。Cmd+Q、应用菜单退出和托盘普通退出现在关闭界面并保留必要后台服务；实例与本地 API 连接继续运行，实例全部结束并回收配置后自动退出。
- 重新打开管理器或从托盘显示主窗口，可继续管理同一组实例。保留明确的「退出并停止运行实例」操作。
- 后台检查实例自然退出，包括网关失效或恢复状态中的存活客户端；客户端退出后完成登录和配置回收。
- Ordinary Quit no longer stops Codex desktop and CLI instances. Cmd+Q, application-menu Quit and ordinary tray Quit close the UI while keeping required background services alive. Instances and local API connections continue; the manager exits after the last instance finishes and configuration cleanup completes.
- Reopening the app or showing its tray window resumes management of the same instances. An explicit “Quit and stop running instances” action remains available.
- Background supervision detects natural client exit, including live clients with failed gateways or recovery status, and completes credential and configuration cleanup afterward.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。请先完成运行中的任务并让管理器彻底退出，再安装新版；账号、实例与本地配置保留。旧版退出行为不会因安装新版而改变。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Finish active work and exit the manager completely before installing; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. Installing this version does not change the exit behavior of an already running older version. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。桌面菜单和语言适配取决于 Codex 版本，Fast 还取决于模型和服务商能力。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Desktop menu and language integration depend on the Codex version; Fast also depends on the model and provider.

## 来源与校验 / Source and verification

版本来源可通过本 Release 的 `v0.4.8` 标签与提交链接核实；构建验证见仓库的 Build release 工作流。下载同一 Release 的 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 后执行 `shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS.txt` 验证安装包。

Verify the source using this Release's `v0.4.8` tag and commit links, and its Build release workflow. Download `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the same Release and run `shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify the installers.
